title: Group Chat and Mixtape
author: Ada Thackeray
blurb: Coral Halloran, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
